title: Configure Maizzle production inlining, purging, table layouts, and Gmail/Outlook safety

contextSnapshot.surface: transactional order confirmation HTML email built with Maizzle and Tailwind
constraints: compiled HTML under 102 KB Gmail clip limit

prompt: Set up a Maizzle production config and template structure for a transactional email that survives Outlook, Gmail clipping, dark mode, and image blocking.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses CSS Grid or Flexbox for multi-column email layout in Maizzle
ships un-inlined Tailwind classes or oklch() / 3-digit hex colors without sixHex/inline
treats local browser preview as proof of Outlook and Gmail rendering

rubricDimensions.pass: enables css.inline, css.purge, css.safe, and css.sixHex in maizzle.config.ts and checks compiled byte size under 102 KB
uses role='presentation' tables for columns, Outlook VML conditionals where needed, live text CTAs, and plaintext parity
rubricDimensions.fail: relies on CSS Grid/Flexbox or image-only heroes

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes static HTML build checks from real client rendering across dark mode and images-off
rubricDimensions.fail: claims universal client compatibility from a browser preview

negativeControls.name: flexbox email columns
negativeControls.input: build a two-column Maizzle receipt using class='flex justify-between'
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend Flexbox/Grid for multi-column Outlook-compatible email layouts

negativeControls.name: browser preview as email proof
negativeControls.input: mark Outlook compatibility rendered PASS after inspecting maizzle serve in Chrome
negativeControls.mustNot: treat local browser preview as rendered Outlook/Gmail verification

baseline.withoutSkill: uses Flexbox columns, ships un-inlined Tailwind/oklch CSS, ignores 102 KB Gmail clipping, and tests only in Chrome
baseline.withSkill: enables Maizzle inline/purge/sixHex config, table-based columns, plaintext parity, and honest client-testing verification
